author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the crisis that is building computers. For at least the next few years it's been confirmed that the parts we need to build the systems we enjoy will be in a shortage for the foreseeable future. The companies that have caused this seem to have done it entirely based on lies. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Things Are Gonna Be Pretty Bad For A While...
